dedupe_keys.name: water reuse and resource recovery from greenhouse wastewater by capacitive electrodialysis at pilot scale

description: The pilot tests single-pass capacitive electrodialysis over 19.32 square metres of membrane area with a capacity of 1–4 cubic metres per day. Experiments vary voltage, cross-flow, staging, recovery and feed composition to recover water and concentrate nutrients from greenhouse wastewater. The authors report irrigation-water conductivity below 0.2 millisiemens per centimetre and sodium below 0.1 millimoles per litre. They compare energy consumption with a modelled reverse-osmosis system, so the reported fourfold difference is not a direct side-by-side plant measurement. The related experimental data are separately catalogued. Performance remains bounded to the tested operating settings and source-described pilot. The source documents a water quality treatment or recovery study. The source authors provide this description through Zenodo, whose deposit declares CC BY 4.0 and public document access. Geographic and temporal coverage remain limited to the cases or observations explicitly described. Only metadata and file descriptors were reviewed; no document, measurements, model archive or code was read. Related components retain their source identities and uncertain experimental overlap.
